decision.reason: [ev-0d3b308e9192] bundles at least four separate changes, each with a different change type and consequence. NameConstraints and UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer are promoted to beta and enabled by default, CAInjectorMerging is a new opt-in gate, and ValidateCAA is deprecated with removal planned for v1.18.0. Because of that, no single subject, change, applicability or consequence can be written for this one item. The cited excerpt also cuts off at CAInjectorMerging, so the ValidateCAA deprecation and its removal release appear only in the change text, not in the evidence shown. The item needs to be split into one change per feature gate, each with evidence covering it.
